name: ghidra
description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
one_liner: A free toolkit that takes a compiled program and turns it back into readable code, letting you see how software actually works even without access to its original source.
buyer: A malware-analysis firm or security consultancy that needs professional-grade reverse-engineering tooling without paying for a commercial alternative like IDA Pro.
business_use_cases: A security firm uses it to analyze malware samples as part of paid incident-response engagements.
A hardware or IoT company reverse-engineers its own legacy firmware to keep maintaining a product whose source code was lost.
A software publisher audits third-party libraries for hidden malicious behavior before shipping a product that depends on them.

money_ideas.idea: Sell hands-on training/workshops teaching teams to use it for malware triage
Build and sell a hosted, collaborative reverse-engineering environment on top of it

steal_this: Package a focused half-day 'Ghidra for malware triage' workshop this weekend and sell seats to security teams — the tool is free and already trusted, so training is the product.
